paragraphs.text: Aryel is a human knight from Urborg on Dominaria , devoted to Lord Windgrace . She has become a knight-commander in Benalia .

Aryel is originally from Urborg , where she trained with the panther warriors . She serves now as a knight -commander in Benalia . She is known for her conquest of the city of Estark in Southern Aerona . Ruthless dedication to the cause of what she considers righteousness is her hallmark, and she leads the knights and soldiers of Benalia on crusades against the evil forces that surround Benalia , including the skin- witches of the Caligo Morass , the minotaurs of Hurloon , the goblins and orcs of the Ironclaw Mountains , and sometimes even the elves of Llanowar . Aryel rides into battle on a huge black panther that shares her merciless nature.
